scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix peace-backend install && npm --prefix peace-web install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web,courier -c blue,magenta,gray "npm --prefix peace-backend run start:dev" "npm --prefix peace-web run dev" "node peace-backend/scripts/mock-bharatship.js"
scripts.build: npm --prefix peace-backend run build && npm --prefix peace-web run build
scripts.db:migrate: cd peace-backend && npx prisma migrate deploy && npx prisma generate
scripts.db:seed: npm --prefix peace-backend run seed && npm --prefix peace-backend run seed:admins
